mapper.insert: insert into medical_record (patient_id, doctor_id, prescription_id, diagnosis, symptoms, chart, remarks, prescription, chief_complaint, present_illness, past_history, physical_exam) values (#{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{prescriptionId}, #{diagnosis}, #{symptoms}, #{chart}, #{remarks}, #{prescription}, #{chiefComplaint}, #{presentIllness}, #{pastHistory}, #{physicalExam})
mapper.update: update medical_record set record_status = 'confirmed' where record_id = #{recordId} and record_status = 'draft'
update medical_record set record_status = 'voided', void_reason = #{voidReason} where record_id = #{recordId}
update medical_record set status = 'archived' where record_id = #{recordId}
update medical_record set status = 'active' where record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.select:
select mr.* from medical_record mr
inner join patient p on mr.patient_id = p.patient_id
mr.status = #{status}
mr.status = 'active'
and p.user_id = #{userId}
and mr.patient_id like concat('%', #{patientId}, '%')
and mr.diagnosis like concat('%', #{diagnosis}, '%')
and mr.symptoms like concat('%', #{symptoms}, '%')
